theme_central: A sharp contrast between faith and disbelief: the deeds of some rendered void, the condition of others set right by Allah.
sources_note: Precisely sourced division (grokipedia, detailed verse breakdown): 1-6, 7-10, 11-15, 16-19, 20-26, 27-32, 33-38.

branches.title: Fundamental contrast
branches.resume: The disbelievers see their deeds rendered void, the believers see their condition set right.

children.t: Deeds of the disbelievers void, condition of the believers set right

branches.title: Allah's help, destroyed cities
branches.resume: If you help Allah, He will help you; fate of the destroyed cities mightier than them.

children.t: Helping Allah's cause to be helped, fate of the destroyed cities

branches.title: Rivers of Paradise, hypocritical criticism
branches.resume: Rivers of water, milk, wine and honey in Paradise; criticism of the hypocritical reading of the Qur'an.

children.t: Rivers of Paradise contrasted with the fate of the disbelievers
Criticism of the hypocritical interpretation, truthfulness of the Prophet affirmed

branches.title: The hypocrites' aversion to fighting
branches.resume: Preference for worldly life, false oaths, aversion to jihad.

children.t: Hypocrites' aversion to jihad, false oaths sworn

branches.title: Regret of the hypocrites
branches.resume: Bitter regret of the hypocrites on the Day of Judgment, contrasted with the joy of the believers.

children.t: Regret of the hypocrites at the Judgment, joy of the believers

branches.title: Obedience, closing
branches.resume: Not invalidating one's deeds through disbelief, warning against greed, Allah's self-sufficiency.

children.t: Obedience to Allah and the Messenger, warning against greed
